frozen_before: Any no-gcc probe, Dockerfile modification, candidate measurement or SSD migration

hdd-candidate.basis: Three runs show runtime apt 460.8-516.3s and gcc including shared lock 515.6-601.2s. Removing gcc may eliminate about55-85s of serialized install plus allow23.5-26.1s uv to overlap runtime apt. Baseline total spread61.65s and export78.9-102.6s require uncertainty margin. Benefits are conditional on no-compiler compatibility.

ssd-final.basis: HDD is active for much of build while CPU mean is about26%. SSD may reduce apt unpack/configuration, layer writes and export. Downloads, compilation and complete functionality remain; no SSD timing has been observed.

model_prediction: Append a separate immutable prediction after the original SSD model baseline and before HDD model measurements; do not overwrite this file.
limitations: n=3 is not a statistical guarantee
Build cache empty does not mean OS or device cache empty
Phase durations overlap and must not be summed
Forecast intervals and adoption thresholds are different criteria
Failure, interruption and migration costs are reported separately
